position.claim: the halakha does not follow him

segments.en: «And Rav Sheshet, son of Rav Idi, said:» One recites that formula «even at the beginning,» in the body of the blessing, instead of the formula: Who distinguishes between sacred and profane. The Gemara comments: «And the halakha is not in accordance with his» opinion.
segments.he: וְרַב שֵׁשֶׁת בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב אִידִי אָמַר: אַף בִּפְתִיחָתָהּ, וְלֵית הִלְכְתָא כְּוָותֵיהּ.

position.claim: the halakha does not follow him

segments.en: The mishna teaches: «Rabbi Dosa says» that the formula is: Who distinguishes «between greater sanctity and lesser sanctity.» The Gemara comments: «And the halakha is not in accordance with his» opinion.
segments.he: רַבִּי דּוֹסָא אוֹמֵר: ״בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ חָמוּר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקַּל״, וְלֵית הִלְכְתָא כְּוָותֵיהּ.
